in_sanskrit.name: Karmjeet
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's work
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Karmjeet एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who performs the will of God or performs the duty assigned to him by the society or his caste.

in_hindi.name: Karmjeet
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's work
in_hindi.long_meaning: Karmjeet एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who performs the will of God or performs the duty assigned to him by the society or his caste.

in_tamil.name: Karmjeet
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God's work
in_tamil.long_meaning: Karmjeet ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who performs the will of God or performs the duty assigned to him by the society or his caste.

in_telugu.name: Karmjeet
in_telugu.long_meaning: Karmjeet ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who performs the will of God or performs the duty assigned to him by the society or his caste.

in_marathi.name: Karmjeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karmjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who performs the will of God or performs the duty assigned to him by the society or his caste.

in_bengali.name: Karmjeet
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's work
